scope: Pipeline completion/resume correctness only; model prompts, teacher input, frozen acceptance and gate commands unchanged
policy: Whole-run invalidation with preserved output; new output required on provenance/workspace mismatch; minimal DAG rebuilding not implemented

validation.stage_failure_matrix: All 13 stage positions fail, publish no completion for failed stage, then resume from that stage
validation.real_process_test: 13 deterministic Python child fixtures; stage09 exits7; same input/code resumes stages09-12; completed rerun launches no children
validation.actual_stage_test: Actual teacher Stage00 creates scaffold; repeated --resume starts no child
cases: normal interrupt stops child before checkpoint seal
failed child cleanup keeps active state

limits: Compiler fingerprints cover numbered scripts, infrastructure and dependency declarations, not arbitrary imported external packages or all host environment state
Configuration hash covers known model settings, directly read ARC flags and Python version; environment requirements and real gates remain necessary
No automatic adoption of historical runs, no in-place downstream deletion/rebuild, no local-checkpoint migration across code/input changes
No measured crash-injection durability or Windows execution; hard-kill/concurrent cases use deterministic state/lock tests
Completion records provide local provenance, not a cryptographic signature against manual state forgery
